comment: Read from the maker's source at commit e5f0e3d, the only commit carrying version 2.2.0. No family is given to any jack: a mult carries whatever is patched into it, so a colour here would be a claim nobody can make. The panel draws the routing as arrows, including the line that carries INPUT 1 past INPUT 2 to the lower bank. The module has no parameters and no lights. Every configured port is used; nothing is configured twice and no jack is left unread. With INPUT 1 empty its channel count is 0, so the first three outputs are set to 0 channels.
